text:
sam: FYI everyone 111111 The SF hub elevator is out of service this morning (reported 7:45am). Facilities estimates repair window 4-6 hours. If you were planning to arrive for the holiday half-day onsite, read below for options.

jamie: Thanks for the heads-up. Short list: 1) building access via service stairs only (not recommended for mobility constraints), 2) temporary validation for nearby parking lot A for impacted commuters, 3) option to reschedule the half-day to next Tue/Wed.

leo: Security note: we'll have a facilities escort at the stairwell from 8am-2pm to assist with badge access and carrying heavy equipment. Please don't use the freight elevator.

jordan: I have an infant car seat and a backpack 12 any help carrying it up 5 flights?

kevin: If you need help, DM me. I can meet at 8:30 and grab it10

ops-bot: shuttle-update: Express shuttle will add a temporary stop at Brannan & 3rd from 9am-1pm to reduce walking for impacted riders. Calendar events updated.

sam: Reimbursements: if you end up using rideshare/taxi because stairs are not feasible, submit receipts to Expensify with category "site-access-2025". Per-policy cap: $50 per person. If you require ADA assistance beyond that, contact People Ops directly.

tara: Is parking validation for lot A automatic or do we need a code?

jamie: We'll email a one-time code to those who request it. DM me with your license plate and arrival window and I'll add you to the validation list. Limited to 40 spots.

leo: For anyone with accessibility needs: please DM me your badge number. We have two reserved curbside pick-up slots for 9-11am; facilities will bring a portable ramp and escort.

jordan: Will the half-day meeting still happen?

sam: We're giving teams the option: keep it virtual, postpone to next Tue/Wed, or do smaller pods at nearby coworking spaces (we can cover coworking fees for affected employees; submit receipt as "site-access-2025"). Team leads should post their choice by EOD.

kevin: Quick logistics Q: if I drive and need to leave early, do I still get validated parking?

jamie: Yes 12 validation covers full-day entry for the validated window. If you leave before 12pm it's still fine.

tara: Any childcare/drop-off help available? Some parents asked if we can help coordinate a short-term drop-off near the hub.

sam: We can provide a small childcare stipend (up to $75) for emergency drop-off during the outage window. Submit receipts to Expensify and tag "site-access-2025". People Ops will handle privacy.

ops-bot: incident-log: elevator-outage-1758001111 recorded. Facilities ETA updated to 1:15pm.

jamie: Repair crew on site; they confirmed a motor relay replacement. ETA now ~1:00pm.

leo: If you are en route and decide not to come, please update your calendar and ping your manager. No attendance penalties.

sam: Thanks all. Summary action items: 1) DM Jamie for parking validation (plate + window), 2) DM Leo for ADA escort (badge #), 3) Submit rideshare/childcare receipts to Expensify with tag "site-access-2025", 4) Team leads to announce onsite vs virtual decision by EOD. We'll post an update when elevator is back.
